title: Interruption Detection & Recovery — Windows restarts, unexpected crashes
one_liner: Detect when sessions are interrupted (crash/restart) and offer guided recovery: resume in-progress work, inspect incomplete entries, or start fresh.
summary: Windows updates (and other system events) cause unexpected restarts mid-session. Currently: wakeup sees in_progress lugs but doesn't know if they're abandoned or waiting. Tracks might be truncated mid-write. Need: (1) Track integrity checks, (2) Interruption detection flag, (3) Recovery prompt with resume path, (4) Autosave checkpoints, (5) Stale lug timeout warnings.
motivation: When a session crashes, the next wakeup should ask 'Resume work?' instead of leaving user confused. Autosave + track integrity = zero work lost between last track entry and crash. This is especially important for long multi-turn epics.
acceptance_criteria: Wakeup Step 7a: Validate track.jsonl final entry — check for `completed` flag or required fields
If invalid/incomplete: Surface 'Session interrupted at Turn N (timestamp)' in briefing
Wakeup Step 8 (new): Interruption recovery prompt — offer Green/Red/Skip/NewProject paths
Wakeup Step 8: Timeout warning for in_progress lugs unchanged >4h — 'Mark abandoned / Resume / Extend?'
Every turn: Autosave checkpoint written to `.autosave/turn-{N}.json` before appending to track
Wakeup Step 6: If track.jsonl corrupted but autosave exists → recover checkpoint
WAI-State.json: Add `_session_status` field: { last_session_id, last_turn, status: clean|interrupted|stale }
Closeout: Set status to 'clean'. Cleanup old autosave files (3+ sessions).
scope: Extend wakeup protocol Steps 6-8 (track validation, recovery prompt, timeout check)
Add `.autosave/` directory management (checkpoint write, cleanup, recovery)
Update track.jsonl schema: require `completed: boolean` for validation
Create recovery skill/logic (similar to green-light/red-light, but for interruptions)
Update briefing display: show interruption warnings prominently
out_of_scope: Recovery from hub-level interruptions (just local spoke)
Time-based auto-cleanup of old autosaves (manual cleanup in closeout)
implementation_notes: Recovery is opt-in and supervised. Green Light = full resume from checkpoint. Red Light = manual inspection. Skip = move on. User always in control.
scope_verified_by: user request (Session 73: recovery mechanism for unexpected restarts)
routing_notes: Framework-wide improvement. Affects wakeup protocol, track schema, and state management. Should be delivered as teaching to all spokes.
